feedback_neg.Comment: I bought this for my office, and it’s exactly what I needed. It’s very sturdy and feels like it’s made to last. It came almost completely assembled—all I had to do was put the wheels on, which only took a few minutes. I also like that the bottom drawer has an extra wheel to help keep it from tipping when it’s open. The lock is a huge plus because I can keep important files and paperwork secure and out of my employees’ hands. I’d definitely buy it again.
